title: CloudWalk Takes Pierre to the Nasdaq Tower
ai_summary: CloudWalk, a Brazilian technology company, has displayed its consumer financial agent Pierre on the Nasdaq Tower in Times Square to signal its operational maturity. The company reported an annualized revenue run-rate of approximately $1.7 billion as of March 2026, with net revenue growing over 100% year-over-year and achieving profitability. CloudWalk's infrastructure processes more than 60 billion tokens daily, representing one of the largest applied AI deployments in the financial services sector.

title: CloudWalk Takes Pierre to the Nasdaq Tower
ai_summary: CloudWalk displayed its AI-powered consumer financial agent, Pierre, on the Nasdaq Tower in Times Square to highlight its operational capabilities.
